items.q: How cold should deliberate cold exposure feel?
items.a: No universal °F — place yourself where it is **uncomfortably cold but safely stayable**. Difficulty rises at night vs afternoon because temperature is **circadian-modulated** (core lowest ~2 h before wake).
Rank: **neck-deep immersion** (hands/feet submerged) > cold shower > cold air. Water transfers heat ~**4× faster** than air.

items.q: Should you stay still in the water?
items.a: No — **move to break the thermal layer**. Stillness makes you warmer and **cheats part of the stimulus**.

items.q: What does cold do to catecholamines?
items.a: Cold spikes **epinephrine/norepinephrine** via skin receptors → locus coeruleus + adrenals. Sramek et al.: **57°F / 14°C × 1 hr** → ~**530% NE**, ~**250% dopamine** sustained **2+ hr** post-exit, **no cortisol spike** (eustress).

items.q: How do you train mental resilience in the cold?
items.a: Count adrenaline **"walls"** instead of fixed time, or do cognitive tasks in cold (boxing-chess analogy). Chosen stress (Ali Crum) ≠ imposed stress.

items.q: What weekly cold dose supports brown-fat thermogenesis?
items.a: Søberg winter-swimmer work: **≥11 min/week total** across **2–4 sessions**. When it gets easy, raise challenge via colder, longer, or more frequent exposure.
**End on cold** and induce **shiver** (during or immediately after) to drive white→beige/brown fat conversion. Caffeine pre-cold may amplify striatal **D2/D3** availability.

items.q: When should you avoid deep cold after lifting?
items.a: Avoid neck-deep immersion **≤4 hr post hypertrophy/strength** (mTOR blunting). OK after endurance/skill; meta-analysis (52 studies) finds post-HIIT immersion ↓ soreness, ↑ power, ↓ CK — **shorter/colder often better**.

items.q: How does palmar cooling boost performance?
items.a: Cool **palms, soles, upper face** (glabrous AVAs) — not so cold as to vasoconstrict. Between-set palm cooling: pull-up volume **+144% over 6 weeks**, bench 1RM **+22% over 10 weeks**; ↓ DOMS. Cool glabrous surfaces for hyperthermia — **not torso towels** (can raise core further).
Evening cold can **raise core temp** and disrupt sleep. Prefer **morning/midday** when you want alertness.
